title: Xerox Star User Interface (1982) 2 of 2
summary: Second half of a demonstration of the 1982 Xerox Star user interface. It shows how the Star differed from the later Lisa and Mac interfaces, with strengths in networking and printing and little direct manipulation.
why: Listed among historical GUI and Smalltalk videos and cited for early features such as math in word processing and the Mesa-programmed Star.
